data.title: Pathlock Recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration
data.description: A recent report by a reputable research firm has shed light on new risks and opportunities in the Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) market. The research emphasizes the importance of making informed decisions in this rapidly evolving sector. Pathlock, a company based in Denver and renowned for its expertise in Converged Identity Governance, ERP Cross-Application Security, and GRC Controls, has been identified as a key player in this market. The report, released on September 4, 2026, underscores the significance of staying up-to-date with developments in IGA and leveraging them for strategic advantage.

data.title: Leverage Shares Files for 2x Long and 2x Short Anthropic ETFs -- ANUU, ANDD and ANSS -- Ahead of the Anthropic IPO
data.description: Anthropic, a company based in Greenwich, Connecticut, is set to go public on September 4, 2026. In preparation for this event, Leverage Shares by Themes is planning to launch three new Anthropic leveraged ETFs. These ETFs will offer active traders daily exposure to Anthropic common stock in different multiples: 2x long, 2x short, and 1x short. This will provide traders with the opportunity to capitalize on movements in the stock price, whether bullish or bearish, with increased leverage.

data.title: FINN Partners Supports Textron Aviation as Agency of Record for 2026 Special Olympics Airlift

data.title: A&S Resources secures railway funding of USD$6 Billion to unlock $2.5 trillion iron ore asset
data.description: The funding for the railway connecting A&S Resources Limited's mineral assets in the Central African Republic (CAR) through Cameroon to global export markets has been secured in London on September 4, 2026. This development signifies a notable advancement in unlocking one of the planet's most extensive mineral reserves.

data.title: SDK.finance Launches a Real-Time General Ledger for Banks and FinTech Companies
data.description: In Lithuania's capital city of Vilnius on September 4th, 2026, SDK.finance introduced an event-driven, double-entry accounting layer. This innovative technology seamlessly converts financial product events into balanced and auditable journal entries. Businesses can integrate this layer without having to replace their current transaction platform. This marks a significant step forward in financial software development and offers companies the ability to enhance their accounting processes.

data.title: National Sheriffs’ Association shifts stance, now ‘neutral’ on CLARITY Act. Previously opposed, they will no longer block the bill.
data.description: The National Sheriffs’ Association, previously against the CLARITY Act due to concerns for consumer protection, has decided to take a different approach. They will now refrain from opposition and allow the legislative process to move forward. This change in stance comes after discussions, and marks a shift in their position on the issue. The CLARITY Act, which has faced criticism and support in equal measure, aims to address consumer protection in various sectors. The Association's decision to stand aside indicates a significant development in the progress of the Act.

data.title: East Point Energy Completes Citrus Flatts Energy Storage Project in Texas
data.description: East Point Energy, a subsidiary of Equinor, has recently finished constructing Citrus Flatts, an energy storage facility boasting a capacity of 100 MW / 200 MWh. Situated in Harlingen, Texas, this project marks East Point's second operational venture in the state. During peak power usage, Citrus Flatts can sustain tens of thousands of households for up to 2 hours. This development reinforces East Point's position as a dependable partner in the region, also contributing towards generating crucial tax revenue to support essential services.

data.title: Banco Comercial Português, SA informs on Interim report on the transactions conducted under the Share Buy-Back Programme
data.description: Commercial Bank of Portugal, SA released a report on transactions made under the Share Buy-Back Programme. The report covers details on the current status of buy-back transactions. It includes information on the total number of shares bought back so far, the average price per share, and the total amount spent on the buy-back programme. This update provides shareholders and investors with insight into the bank's efforts to repurchase its own shares.
